name: karens-kitchen-sourdough
description: Artisan Sourdough ordering system with backend database persistence.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const file = 'public/app.js'; let content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); content = content.replace(/__BACKEND_URL_PREFIX__/g, process.env.BACKEND_URL_PREFIX || ''); fs.writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');"
